title: Ramayana Part 1 grosses Rs 1,228 cr worldwide in 10 days (Sacnilk; BH Rs 1,215.40 cr), past Jawan's lifetime; 2nd Saturday Rs 72.90 cr net
headline: Ramayana Crosses ₹1,200 Crore, Passes Jawan's Lifetime in 10 Days
caption:
Ramayana: Rise of a Legend, Part 1 of Nitesh Tiwari's two-film Ramayana, has grossed ₹1,228 crore worldwide in its first 10 days in cinemas, to Saturday 14 November, trade tracker Sacnilk estimates. That is past the ₹1,160 crore Sacnilk records for Jawan's entire run, and ₹2 crore short of RRR's ₹1,230 crore.

Bollywood Hungama's count is ₹1,215.40 crore, also past the ₹1,148.32 crore it gives for Jawan's lifetime. Both are trade estimates, not figures from the producers.

In India, Saturday brought ₹72.90 crore net, up 51.6% on Friday, per Sacnilk. Bollywood Hungama puts the day at ₹68.72 crore and calls it the biggest second Saturday on record.

After its cinema run, Ramayana goes pay-per-view on JioHotstar, Prime Focus Studios says; the date and price are not out yet.

Did you catch Ramayana in its first 10 days, or are you waiting for the crowds to thin out?

Sources: Sacnilk, Bollywood Hungama, Prime Focus, The Hollywood Reporter India
